items.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has deep ties to the chipmaker
items.summary: In late September, Cantor Fitzgerald hosted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and other top executives from the chipmaker for investor meetings in New York, according to a Cantor research report reviewed by CNBC.

items.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says central bank 'has definitely got work to do' on inflation
items.summary: Chicago Federal Reserve President Austan Goolsbee expressed concern about the latest inflation data, telling CNBC on Friday that the central bank likely will need to take action.

items.title: How the Jensen Huang affair changes the outlook for U.S.-China relations
items.summary: BEIJING — Prolonged U.S. Congressional scrutiny of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy raises the stakes for already tense relations between the world's two largest economies.

items.title: Oil prices rise after Trump says no Iran deal needed: 'We've got their Strait'
items.summary: U.S. oil prices rose Thursday, as comments from President Donald Trump stoked worries that an end to the U.S.-Iran war was not in sight.

items.title: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds
items.summary: Threats from artificial intelligence topped the list for greatest risks to the financial system, far exceeding any other dangers, according to respondents who participated in a Federal Reserve survey released Friday.

items.title: Wholesale prices rose 0.3% in October, putting annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years
items.summary: Wholesale prices increased less than expected in October, but inflation pressures persisted and the Federal Reserve is likely still on target for an interest rate increase soon.

items.title: Bessent blames Lutnick’s Commerce as he slams Nvidia chip ‘leakage’ to China
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Friday said his department and others in the Trump administration have long supported imposing restrictions on Megaspeed, the company at the center of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 's spy-sex scandal .
